title: FontCore manifest (fonts.json), schema version 1
description: The manifest at the root of a FontCore vault. Every object may carry fields not listed here; readers must ignore them and writers must preserve them. Name extension fields after your app id (for example "ai.storytold.photocraft:recent") so they cannot collide with fields added to this schema later.

schema_version.description: Manifest layout version. Additive changes keep version 1; a reader must refuse a version it does not know.

font.description: One font file stored in the vault.

id.description: The first 16 hex digits of sha256.

file.description: Path of the font file relative to the vault root: '/'-separated, non-empty segments with no '.', '..', '\' or ':'.

format.description: Container format. 'ttc' covers both .ttc and .otc collections. Variable fonts use these same values; WOFF/WOFF2 are never stored.

faces.description: Every face in the file, in collection order. Single-face files have exactly one.

enabled.description: false hides the whole file from apps, whatever its faces say.

apps.description: Apps allowed to load this font. Omitted or empty means every app.

source.description: File name the font was imported from.

face.description: Naming and style information for one face, plus whether apps may load it.

index.description: Index of the face in the file; 0 for single-face files.

enabled.description: false hides this face from apps; the other faces of a collection stay available.

app_id.description: Lowercase reverse-DNS app id with at least three labels, such as ai.storytold.photocraft.

license.description: An SPDX license expression as a string ("OFL-1.1", "MIT OR Apache-2.0"), or {"custom": "..."} for a license with no SPDX identifier.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time with an uppercase 'T' and an explicit 'Z' or ±HH:MM offset, such as 2026-10-22T02:30:00Z.
